semantic_label: sporepedia asset load: reset the inline entry vector, resolve the primary or secondary source record, either replay a global record range or build the keyed entry vector with three tag tests, then take the maximum entry value

abi.frame: SUB ESP,0x28 / PUSH EBX / PUSH EBP / PUSH ESI / PUSH EDI; the receiver is copied to EBX and EDI points at the inline entry vector subobject at +0x40

stack_arguments.note: a null source skips both lookup branches and still zeroes max_6c and runs the gate scan

mechanics: write the state word 2 to +0x2c as the very first action
call the clear port 0x011e0744 with the entry vector first, last and a count argument computed as last minus last, that is zero
rewind the entry vector end at +0x44 by the cleared span expressed in bytes, derived from (last - first) divided by four and negated
with a null source skip both lookup branches, still zero max_6c and still run the gate scan
look up the primary record with the selector 0x0670da17 through source vtable slot +0x0c and retain it through its slot +0x00 when non null
look up the secondary record with the selector 0x03c609f8 through the same slot and retain it the same way
when the primary is present call the range port 0x005507a0 twice and replay every 0x0c record between range first and range last through asset vtable slot +0xb4
otherwise when only the secondary is present copy the keyed set word at +0x18 to asset +0x28
fill a 0x10 byte tag with the key fill port 0x004babe0 and run three mask tests 0x004f3d60 against the globals 0x015da8e0, 0x015dab18 and 0x015da80c, storing the low bytes at +0x25, +0x24 and +0x26
collect the keyed entries with 0x004f5720 into a stack triple and, when the call reports true, reserve the inline vector with 0x00642070 sized by the collected span in words
append each collected element in place when the vector end is below the capacity, advancing +0x44 by one word first, otherwise call the out of line insert port 0x0060a600
free the collected vector through 0x00f47380 when its first pointer is non null and the word one below it is nonzero
zero max_6c at +0x6c, then require the gate lookup 0x0067dea0 to be non null before the entry scan
re-call the gate lookup once per inline entry, resolve it through the entry lookup port 0x007db5e0, and keep the signed maximum of entry value +0x04 against the current max_6c
release the secondary then the primary through handle vtable slot +0x04 at the end
the gate lookup port is called once for the null test and once more per entry, so the count depends on the inline span
